label: 流墨研究生・向上跑步及待機起停轉跳16格八欄原畫分件

provenance.method: Each own graduate UP native pose is independently partitioned. Built-in image_gen provides concealed cloth, underclothes and cap-under hair material. The visible original identity is retained from the same native pose.
provenance.normalIdentity: Own same-cell visible hair, ears, nape and turn3 side-face keep their original nonzero RGBA. Other normal layers clear every nonzero body-front pixel.
provenance.nativeWearables: Original visible wearable RGB is retained; native alpha >=240 is promoted to255, with lower-alpha outlines retained. This does not claim original garment RGBA equality.
provenance.compact: Same-source LANCZOS 0.375 resize with body-front alpha>=248 core protection. No old character border-coordinate cleanup is used.

independentIdentityLandmarks.scope: 80 independently frozen own-native hair/ear/side-face probes; sparse points do not replace full body-layer preservation or visual review.

provenance.frontItems: Native front-held book and chest pin are naturally fully hidden in these16 UP cells. Their independent slot passes remain explicitly transparent with per-cell reasons. The native rear gold round/diamond ornament belongs to the cape.
provenance.fallback: Only these16 cells and the256 pineapple/null combinations are added. The sealed front idle and all other actual-loadout fallback and race-handling code are retained.
provenance.coverageClaimScope: Existing native pose-cell layering only; actual pixel/UI/delivery acceptance is recorded separately.
